description: A Python script implementing a GUI application that uses asynchronous pipelines to generate and display calendar images and audio descriptions for specific months, integrating multiple services and custom frame processors.

classes.name: ImageDescription
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that extracts text from TextFrame objects to store image descriptions.

classes.name: AudioGrabber
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that collects audio data from TTSAudioRawFrame frames and creates an OutputAudioRawFrame.

classes.name: ImageGrabber
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that captures URLImageRawFrame frames for later use.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up the GUI, pipelines, and tasks to generate calendar images and audio descriptions for specified months.
